sentences.text: This writ petition is submitted by the petitioner, being aggrieved by the denial of payment due to the 1st petitioner firm, as evidenced by Ext.P6, by the 4th respondent Corporation.
Today when the matter came up for consideration, it was submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that now the entire amount due to the petitioner has been released.

In such circumstances, further orders are not necessary accordingly, this writ petition is closed,
recording the above submission.

Sd/-
